description: Elliott sought investor consent to amend the governining documents of Elliott International Limited (the "Fund") to: (1) update certain terms  to be consistent with Elliott's understanding of what is standard in the industry, and in certain instances, also align such terms between the Fund and Elliott Associates, L.P. and (2) clarify how Elliott will manage and operate their business.
